cards.title: The last seat cannot go twice
items: The seat claim is a conditional UPDATE with the capacity test inside it
Two simultaneous registrants race the same row, and one of them loses cleanly
capacity = 0 means uncapped, and the same statement handles it

cards.title: The seat follows the status, not the row
items: On an approval event the count stays put until an organiser decides
So registeredCount always means "people who are coming", never "forms received"
Approving a queue that no longer fits stops at the capacity line instead of overselling

cards.title: The ticket is a URL, not a file
items: The QR is rendered as inline SVG on each request — nothing in S3, nothing to clean up
It is null until the registration is approved, so a pending applicant gets no scannable pass
Check-in is idempotent: the stamp only lands while checked_in_at is still NULL

cards.title: Feedback opens on the clock
items: The link resolves only once the event's endAt has passed
A unique index on registration_id is the real guarantee of one response per ticket
Two tabs on the same ticket hit that index rather than a check that can race
